name: @ecoma-io/llm-api
//: Deploy unit `llm-api` — data plane LLM tren Cloudflare Workers, soan boi
runtime Rust (workers-rs) dich ra WASM. `pg` nam o dependencies cho
`db/apply.mts` — migration runner chay o CI runner (Node), khong thuoc
bundle Worker (HD6: Hyperdrive khong ho tro advisory lock).
Ba domain lib `@ecoma-io/llm-*-domain` chi phuc vu bootstrap runner 8a/8b
duoi `db/` (chay tren Node qua tsx, khong thuoc bundle Worker): domain op
la duong code duy nhat de seed, khong co SQL ghi du lieu tu do.
Runtime Worker khong co dependency TS nao: HTTP, routing va ket noi
Hyperdrive dien ra trong crate Rust (apps/llm-api/src, Cargo.toml).
`testcontainers` chi phuc vu suite integration app-owned duoi `tests/`.
`worker-build` goi cargo build cho target wasm32-unknown-unknown va
sinh `build/index.js` + `build/index.wasm` (entry ma `wrangler.jsonc`
main tro vao). Toolchain pin bang `rust-toolchain.toml` (1.98.1 +
target wasm32); cargo toolchain khac tren may se bi override.
`worker-build` phai duoc cargo install truoc (prerequisite duoc
ghi tai README cua project).
Runner migration canonical (02-delivery.md §3): chay o CI runner voi
credential migrator cua tung DB (db-llm-gateway / db-llm-tenant /
db-llm-marketplace). Target luon khong cacheable vi no mutate DB that.
Target `test` = unit test colocated cua project (06-testing.md §4).
Voi runtime Rust, day la `cargo test` tren host toolchain (spec nam
trong src/). Suite integration (PostgreSQL that qua testcontainers)
nam o target `test-integration` voi config rieng.
Khong `build` trong dependsOn: cargo test tu build phan can thiet.

options.command: npx vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mts tests/integrations tests/databases

//: Suite integration app-owned (PostgreSQL that qua testcontainers):
ranh gioi quyen runtime/migrator, serialization advisory lock,
migration idempotent. Import thang TS nguon (`db/apply.mts`) — khong
doc artifact build.
`dependsOn: build` cho suite HTTP contract (`tests/integrations/http-
contract.spec.ts`, review PR #113): suite boot runtime Worker that
tu artifact `build/index.js` ma target `build` sinh ra qua
`worker-build` — thieu artifact thi harness `listen()` nem ngay, do
thay vi pass rong. Cung hinh `test-integration` cua `apps/backoffice`.
Lint hai mat TS (oxlint cho db/, tests/, config) va Rust (rustfmt
check + clippy deny warnings) — theo §9 cua 05-code-architecture.md:
per-project nx:run-commands boc cargo, khong @monodon/rust.
Mat TS cua project chi con `db/` + `tests/` (runtime la Rust, khong
co TS app) nen khong co tsconfig.app.json — solution chi reference
tsconfig.spec.json.
